name: ceilingdesign-walk-simple
description: Simple ladder for per-room ceiling design (CUSTOMIZE-CEILING, `ceilingDesign` flag — pro tier). Confirms the flag is OFF in Simple mode, switches to Pro, applies a tray ceiling with a cove light to the Living/Dining room, enters walk mode, teleports the walker near the tray's north edge and pitches the FirstPersonCamera up via the dev-only `__walkLook` lever (mouse-look needs Pointer Lock and touch-look needs synthetic multi-touch, both impractical headless) to prove the recess/riser/cove geometry actually renders from below. A second look-up covers the coffered 3x3 variant under dusk + lights-on so the beam grid reads in relief. GOTCHA: a near-vertical pitch (>1.2 rad) from the room centre fills the whole FOV with the tray's flat centre panel — a featureless frame that proves nothing. Stand ~1 m from a recess edge and pitch ~1.0 rad so the frame step + riser + cove strip are IN frame.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: verify-simple-default
steps.failMessage: app should boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-ceilingdesign-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: ceilingDesign is a pro-tier flag and must be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-ceilingdesign-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: ceilingDesign should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: bump-quality-tier
steps.comment: High+ unlocks the riser/box-wall strips + cove-light glow (RoomCeiling gates them on qualityTier) so the walk-mode screenshot shows the full designed look, not just the bare flat-per-height planes Performance renders.

steps.name: apply-tray-ceiling
steps.comment: Deep drop + wide margin so the recess step is unmistakable; saturated warm cove colour so the emissive strips read even under flat headless lighting.
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setRoomCeiling('livingDining', { style: 'tray', drop: 0.3, margin: 0.6, coveLight: true, coveColor: '#ffb870' })

steps.name: verify-ceiling-config-persisted

waitFor.store: (() => { const r = state.floorPlan.rooms.find(r => r.id === 'livingDining'); return !!r && r.ceiling && r.ceiling.style === 'tray' && r.ceiling.drop === 0.3 && r.ceiling.coveLight === true; })()

steps.failMessage: tray ceiling config did not persist on the livingDining room

steps.name: teleport-near-north-recess
steps.comment: livingDining spans x 8.55-12.55, z 1.4-6.8; margin 0.6 puts the tray's inner (recess) north edge at z=2.0. Standing at z=3.1 looking north (the spawn yaw) puts that edge ~1.1 m ahead — at eye 1.6 under a 2.6 m ceiling the riser + cove strip sit ~42 deg up, inside a pitched-up FOV. Position-only teleport per the playbook (the frame loop re-asserts orientation but only writes x/z on movement input).

steps.name: verify-pitch-applied
steps.failMessage: the dev __walkLook lever did not persist the pitch onto the frame loop's ref

steps.name: switch-to-coffered
steps.comment: Second variant: a 3x3 coffered beam grid, still at daylight hour 13. Do NOT turn ceiling lights on for a pitched-up shot: a point light straight ahead of the look-up camera + high-tier bloom blows the whole frame out to white (found the hard way). Daylight ambient already shades the two ceiling heights distinctly (the tray shot proves it).

steps.name: verify-coffered-config

waitFor.store: (() => { const r = state.floorPlan.rooms.find(r => r.id === 'livingDining'); return !!r && r.ceiling && r.ceiling.style === 'coffered' && r.ceiling.grid && r.ceiling.grid[0] === 3; })()

steps.failMessage: coffered ceiling config did not persist on the livingDining room

waitFor.store: (() => { const r = state.floorPlan.rooms.find(r => r.id === 'livingDining'); return !!r && r.ceiling && r.ceiling.style === 'coffered'; })()
